en.t: Surely you did not come all this way just to visit the spring countryside.
The handwriting was very practiced and elegant.

units.source_text: 隔川两庄院中都奏着悠扬悦耳的音乐，川风有意沟通，吹来吹去，教彼此互相听赏。

en.t: In both estates across the river, graceful and pleasing music was being played, and the river wind seemed deliberately to carry it back and forth, letting each side listen to and enjoy the other.
